content.text: On August 28, 2026, the general discussion channel saw routine morning greetings from several members including NotForHumans, MicoM.ron, and ValleyBeyond. Later in the evening, a user named Luancryptodev posted what appeared to be a scam or phishing message disguised as an official project relaunch announcement, claiming holders should contact them directly to receive new token allocations. This type of message is a common social engineering tactic used to defraud crypto community members. A Helper role user named flame quickly responded by flagging the message, redirecting the user to post in an appropriate channel, and included what appears to be a suspicious or obfuscated Discord invite link in their warning. The warning message received a negative reaction from community members, suggesting the moderation response itself may have also been flagged as suspicious. The incident highlights ongoing risks of scam announcements within crypto-related Discord communities.
